name: Decay Breath VR
summary:
Game Characteristics ：

Hard gun assembly and shooting

Realistic gun assembly system, players can disassemble and assemble magazines, magnifiers, sights and manually stuff bullets. Personally adjust weapon parts and assemble your firearms, enjoy every moment of pleasure from precision shooting. Use customized weapons to accurately shoot heads or sever limbs to repel the surging zombie army.
